role: The End's boss fight as the whole-server replay carries it: builds the dragon and crystals of a v2 snapshot (NBT plus Snapshot.java's unsaved dragon state, no constructor draws); constructs the EntityDragon at 0,128,0 and the WorldGenSpikes crystals (keeping the crystals across the dragon's init), tracks which chunk and section the 16-wide dragon was added to so entity searches find it the way vanilla does, reloads a saved dragon, counts the End's listed entities, and writes the dragon's and crystals' NBT for the entity digest.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 17-19 and 129-135, functions endfight_spawn_dragon and endfight_reload_dragon: copy the 64-crystal array to the stack and back around dragon_init (about 64 x 100 bytes of stack)
line 78-81, function endfight_dragon_nbt: builds an nbt tree (heap) for the digest
notes: Callers: serverreplay.c and sr_digest.c (pools SR_POOL_DRAGON 4 and SR_POOL_CRYSTAL 5); no test calls endfight_ directly. The dragon's NBT is produced by filling a throwaway living (kind 1000, attributes maxHealth 200) and calling living_write_nbt; the crystal's through ent_nbt_base. Recordings: out/java/snapshots/end-arrival-s1, end-crystals-s1, end-dragon-s1, end-exit-s1 (DEVLOG 2026-09-25 lane/theend). lane/anytick: endfight_snapshot_crystal takes the runtime isDead (a crystal destroyed in the tick before the snapshot leaves in the next entity pass).
